```{r}
#| label: setup-dat
#| include: false
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(sf)
eccc_core <-
  "c:/users/hoped/OneDrive - EC-EC/Avian_Core_20251124.xlsx" |>
  readxl::read_excel()

soc_groups <- read_csv("SOCB_Report_Groups_2024.csv")
paired_sum <- read_rds(
  "RAW_DATA/ATLAS_RAW_DATA/Ontario_BBA3_draft5/data_clean/model_output/paired_summaries/paired_summaries.rds"
) |>
  transpose() |>
  pluck("shared_change_summary") |>
  list_rbind() |>
  mutate(model_name = "Paired Sites - Point Counts", sp_english = sp_name)

paired_sum_aru <-
  read_rds(
    "RAW_DATA/ATLAS_RAW_DATA/Ontario_BBA3_draft5/data_clean/model_output/paired_summaries/paired_summaries_with_ARU.rds"
  ) |>
  transpose() |>
  pluck("shared_change_summary") |>
  list_rbind() |>
  mutate(model_name = "Paired Sites - PC_ARU", sp_english = sp_name)


paired <- bind_rows(paired_sum, paired_sum_aru) |>
  mutate(
    pct_change_median = pct_change_q50,
    pct_change_qlow = pct_change_q10,
    pct_change_qhigh = pct_change_q90
  )

sg <- distinct(
  soc_groups[soc_groups$include...4 == 'Y', ],
  english_name,
  Group
) |>
  mutate(
    sp_english = case_when(
      english_name == "Herring Gull" ~ "American Herring Gull",
      english_name == "Warbling Vireo" ~ "Eastern Warbling Vireo",
      english_name ==
        "Golden-winged x Blue-winged Warbler" ~ "Golden-winged/Blue-winged Warbler",
      english_name == "Whimbrel" ~ "Hudsonian Whimbrel",
      english_name == "House Wren" ~ "Northern House Wren",
      english_name == "Yellow Warbler" ~ "Northern Yellow Warbler",
      str_detect(english_name, "Rock Pigeon") ~ "Rock Pigeon (Feral Pigeon)",
      str_detect(english_name, "Redpoll") ~ "Redpoll",
      TRUE ~ english_name
    )
  )

d_change_models <-
  list.files(
    "RAW_DATA/ATLAS_RAW_DATA/Ontario_BBA3_draft5/data_clean/model_output",
    "regional_change_estimates\\w+.rds",
    recursive = T,
    full.names = T
  ) |>
  str_subset("_PC_ARU_SS", negate = T) |>
  map(read_rds) |>
  list_rbind() |> 
  filter(model_name != "PC_ARU_CL") 

mod_ss <- d_change_models[d_change_models$model_name=="PC_ARU_CL_SS",]
d_change_models <- 
  bind_rows(
    mod_ss,
    filter(d_change_models, model_name=="PC_ARU" & sp_english %notin% mod_ss$sp_english )
  )



d_change <-
  d_change_models |>
  bind_rows(
    paired |>
      left_join(
        distinct(d_change_models, Region_Number, Region_Name),
        by = join_by(BCR == Region_Number)
      ) |>
      select(any_of(names(d_change_models)))
  ) |>
  mutate(
    fc_region = factor(
      Region_Name,
      levels = c(
        "Province-wide",
        "Lower Great Lakes / St. Lawrence Plain",
        "Temperate Mixed",
        "Boreal Shield West",
        "Boreal Shield East",
        "Hudson Plains"
      )
    ),
    change_group = case_when(
       (pct_change_qlow<0&pct_change_qhigh<0)~"Decline",
       ( pct_change_qlow<0&pct_change_qhigh>0)~"Increase",
        TRUE~"Uncertain or no change"
    )
  )

d_change_gr <- d_change |>
  left_join(
    sg,
    by = join_by(sp_english)
  ) |>
  replace_na(list(Group = "None"))


plot_spp <- function(df) {
  df |>
    ggplot(aes(sp_english, pct_change_median)) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = 2) +
    # geom_line(aes(group = sp_english), alpha = 0.2)
    geom_pointrange(
      aes(
        ymin = pct_change_qlow,
        ymax = pct_change_qhigh,
        # colour = model_name
      ),
      position = position_dodge(width = 0.3)
    ) +
    theme_minimal() +
    scale_x_discrete(guide = guide_axis(angle = 45)) +
    labs(y = "Median % Change between atlas 2 and 3", x = NULL) +
    facet_wrap(~Group)
}
```

```{r}


gen_dist <- function(spp_code, model_name) {
  # browser()
  f_ <- list.files(
    glue::glue(
      "RAW_DATA/ATLAS_RAW_DATA/Ontario_BBA3_draft5/data_clean/model_output/rasters_{model_name}/"
    ),
    glue::glue("^{spp_code}_a\\d.tif"),
    full.names = T
  )
  if (length(f_) == 0) {
    return(NULL)
  }
  r <- terra::rast(f_)

  cent_ <- r |>
    terra::centroids(weighted = T)
  cents_sf <-
    cent_ |>
    mutate(
      lyr = names(r),
      atlas = rep(str_extract(f_, "a2|a3"), each = 2),
      species = spp_code
    ) |>
    st_as_sf(coords = c("x", "y"), crs = terra::crs(r), remove = F) |>
    filter(lyr == "mu_q50") |>
    mutate(model_name = model_name)

  dist_move <- cents_sf |>
    st_transform(3161) %>%
    st_distance(.[1, ], .[2, ]) |>
    units::set_units('km') %>%
    .[2, 1]

  azimuth_rad <- st_transform(cents_sf, 4326) |> lwgeom::st_geod_azimuth()
  azimuth_deg <- units::set_units(azimuth_rad, "degrees")

  list(
    change = tibble(
      species = spp_code,
      model_name = model_name,
      change_deg = azimuth_deg,
      change_rad = azimuth_rad,
      change_dist_km = dist_move
    ),
    centroids = cents_sf
  )
}

all_mods <-
  map(
    c("PC_ARU", "PC_ARU_CL", "PC_ARU_CL_SS"),
    ~ {
      rast_og <- list.files(
        glue::glue(
          "RAW_DATA/ATLAS_RAW_DATA/Ontario_BBA3_draft5/data_clean/model_output/rasters_{.x}/"
        ),
        "_a\\d.tif"
      )

      tibble(
        model_name = .x,
        spp_code = str_remove_all(rast_og, "_(a2|a3).tif") |> unique()
      )
    }
  ) |>
  list_rbind()

# future::plan(future::multisession(workers = 12))
# all_spp_res <- pmap(all_mods, gen_dist) |> futurize::futurize()
# future::plan(future::sequential())
# write_rds(all_spp_res, "RAW_DATA/Raw_species_res_distance.rds")
all_spp_res <-read_rds( "RAW_DATA/Raw_species_res_distance.rds")

# gen_dist("blue_winged_warbler", "PC_ARU")

all_dists <- all_spp_res |> transpose() |> pluck("change") |> list_rbind() |> 
  mutate(abs_change =abs(units::drop_units(change_deg)),
  abs_dist =  abs(units::drop_units(change_dist_km))) |> 
    left_join(d_change[d_change$Region_Number=='province',], by = join_by(model_name, species==sp_file)) |> 
    mutate(delta_x = sin(change_rad)* change_dist_km,
    delta_y = cos(change_rad)* change_dist_km) |> 
       filter( (model_name=="PC_ARU" & sp_english %notin% mod_ss$sp_english) |(model_name == "PC_ARU_CL_SS"))
all_centroids <- all_spp_res |>
  transpose() |>
  pluck("centroids") |>
  list_rbind() |> 
  filter( (model_name=="PC_ARU" & species %notin% mod_ss$sp_file) |(model_name == "PC_ARU_CL_SS"))
```

comp_mod_dist <- 
all_dists |> select(species, model_name, abs_dist) |>

  # dplyr::filter(n > 1L) |> glimpse()
  pivot_wider(names_from = model_name, values_from =abs_dist)  |> 
    filter(!is.na(species))
    # filter(is.na(PC_ARU))
    ggplot() +
      geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype=2) +
    geom_point(data=comp_mod_dist, 
    aes(PC_ARU, PC_ARU_CL)) +
    ggrepel::geom_text_repel(data =comp_mod_dist[(!is.na(comp_mod_dist$PC_ARU) &comp_mod_dist$PC_ARU>200),],
  aes(PC_ARU, PC_ARU_CL, label = species) ) +
    theme_minimal() +
    labs(title = "Change in absolute distance (km)")
